# bob prose

Format, inspect, extract, and inline prose notes

```text title="bob prose --help"
Format, inspect, extract, and inline prose notes (frontmatter type: "[[prose]]").

Every `bob prose` command reads or rewrites prose notes. `[[article]]` notes still count. bob owns their section numbers (1. / 1.1 / 1.1.1) and layout; formatting never changes a word. `extract` moves an authored heading section into a prose note, and `inline` folds it back through its unique link stub. Both preview before writing. Bare `bob prose` runs the read-only `list` command.

Usage: bob prose [OPTIONS]
       bob prose <COMMAND>

Commands:
  adopt    Mark a note as a prose note; preview unless --write
  extract  Move a section into a new prose note, leaving a link stub
  format   Number sections and tidy layout in prose notes
  inline   Fold a prose note back into its parent section
  list     List prose notes with sections, TODO stubs, and findings
  outline  Print a prose note's numbered section outline
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <PATH>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  bob prose                                      List prose notes
  bob prose adopt blog                          Preview adopting a note
  bob prose extract job_2026 -s "Why I left Google?"  Preview extracting a section
  bob prose inline job_2026_why_i_left_google    Preview inlining it
  bob prose format blog                         Format one prose note
  bob prose outline blog                        Numbered outline with word counts

See docs/prose.md for the rules and JSON contract.
```
